title: Make build2 the default trial kind
item: Make the new way of testing the agent-spec skill the default one that /trial, /grade and /iterate use, and mark the two old ways as retired
motivation: Today a plain /iterate would test the new skill the old way, which fails or gives meaningless numbers. The owner ruled the old ways retire once the new baseline is graded, which happened 2026-11-15
notes: The commands read grading.json, which still describes only the old trial kinds (full: review step on the old 1,544-line spec; build: old skill with the recorded interview replayed). The new kind (build2: whole new skill, stand-in owner, baseline trials 10–12) sits in grading-new.json. Small file work, no trials, its own commit. Do before the next change to the skill (items 24–26). Old trial folders stay as history. Same commit or the next: rewrite eval/agent-spec/README.md, which still describes the old test setup; delete the merged branch agent-spec/switch and the older stale branches. 2026-11-15, owner: tasks 38 and 39 folded in; the retry continues from task/028. That branch also adds tasks/038-040; at merge keep the working branch's copies.
done_means: grading.json describes the build2 kind with baseline trials 10 to 12 and marks the two old kinds retired. /trial, /grade and /iterate use build2 by default. Grading the baseline gives the same numbers as before. Old trial folders are unchanged. The eval README describes the new setup. The grader tests read grading.json and pass; grading-new.json is removed. grading-schema.md describes default_kind, kinds.<kind>.prompt and the RETIRED prefix.
draft_note: Owner chose this as the manager's second task; mark Ready after the first run passes. Its note also asks to delete merged and stale branches: that is a delete, so list them and park it for the owner.

decided_for_you.chosen: Merge build2 into grading.json and keep the retired kinds there
decided_for_you.would_change: If old kinds should be graded only through a separate file (a new grading-old.json would need may_edit)

decided_for_you.rejected: Delete it or make it a pointer
decided_for_you.would_change: Task 038 lands and no test names it

decided_for_you.chosen: New fields default_kind and kinds.<kind>.prompt, read by trial.md and iterate.md
decided_for_you.would_change: You prefer the naming rule; task 039 documents the fields in grading-schema.md

decided_for_you.chosen: Park instead of merging with one failing protected test
decided_for_you.rejected: Merge and leave the test failing until 038
decided_for_you.would_change: You accept a temporarily failing test

decided_for_you.chosen: Branch deletion listed in needs_you, not done
decided_for_you.would_change: Never; the manager may not delete branches
